value.rationale: The precise central-vertex wheel sequence was already singled out in the 2024 primary paper as lacking a formula. The rational function resolves this motivated enumerative gap and, more strongly, determines each cardinality coefficient of all minimal forts in a natural infinite graph family. The result is not merely a scalar known-table recomputation.
